'''Suns' Set Ridge''' was the name given to the ridge that formed the southern edge of [[the Wound]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was named for the twin [[Star/Legends|suns]] of the planet, and the [[Ridgeside Sentry Post]] was built atop the upper ridge.<ref name="TOR:SSR" />
